zh-CN.title: 桌面语音支持实时转文字
items: 展开输入框的语音面板实时展示识别文字，可直接转入草稿，编辑后发送。
保留语音试听与发送，关闭面板或切换聊天时自动结束录制。

en.title: Live transcription for desktop voice input
items: See recognized speech live in the expanded composer, then add it directly to your draft to edit and send.
Preview and send voice recordings as before. Closing the panel or switching chats ends recording.
